name: Menu bar with File, Edit, View, Entity and Help menus
body:
# Menu bar

`MenuBar.chaos`: one `MenuButton` per menu, a menu opened as an absolutely positioned frame at `--z-menu` over a
full-window transparent backdrop (Cosmos `position: fixed`), closed by a click outside, by Escape (`onKeyDown` on the
menu) or by choosing an item. Items show their shortcut on the right, disabled items are greyed (Undo with nothing to
undo), toggles show a check (Snap, Grid), and submenus (Entity > Add, File > Open Recent) open on hover.

Menu contents: File (New, Open..., Open Recent, Save, Save As..., Revert, Quit); Edit (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste,
Duplicate, Delete, Select All, Deselect, Focus Selection); View (Grid, Snap, Colliders, Markers, Wireframe outlines,
Camera presets, Reset Camera, Settings...); Entity (Add > templates, Parent to Selection, Unparent, Rename); Help
(Controls, About).

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. MenuBar.chaos and MenuPopup.chaos over a <portal>; menus are MenuEntry data from editor-menus.nyx (File, Edit, Selection, View, Entity, Window, Help), dispatched by EditorApplication.RunCommand. Decision D-033.
